description: Returns whether a blockhash is still valid or not

parameters.name: blockhash
parameters.description: The hash of the block encoded as base-58 string

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: An object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: finalized
sub_parameters.description: the node will query the most recent block confirmed by supermajority of the cluster as having reached maximum lockout, meaning the cluster has recognized this block as finalized.

sub_parameters.name: confirmed
sub_parameters.description: the node will query the most recent block that has been voted on by supermajority of the cluster.

sub_parameters.name: processed
sub_parameters.description: the node will query its most recent block. Note that the block may not be complete.

parameters.name: minContextSlot
parameters.description: The minimum slot at which the request can be evaluated

result.description: True if the blockhash is still valid otherwise false
